package main

// Verifies the signed session tokens issued by this project's identity service. Generated by Tessery.

import (
	"crypto/hmac"
	"crypto/sha256"
	"encoding/base64"
	"encoding/json"
	"net/http"
	"os"
	"strings"
	"time"
)

type Session struct {
	Sub   string `json:"sub"`
	Email string `json:"email"`
	Role  string `json:"role"`
	Exp   int64  `json:"exp"`
}

var authSecret = []byte(os.Getenv("AUTH_SECRET"))

func verifySession(token string) *Session {
	parts := strings.Split(token, ".")
	if len(parts) != 3 || len(authSecret) == 0 {
		return nil
	}
	mac := hmac.New(sha256.New, authSecret)
	mac.Write([]byte(parts[0] + "." + parts[1]))
	sig, err := base64.RawURLEncoding.DecodeString(parts[2])
	if err != nil || !hmac.Equal(sig, mac.Sum(nil)) {
		return nil
	}
	body, err := base64.RawURLEncoding.DecodeString(parts[1])
	if err != nil {
		return nil
	}
	var s Session
	if json.Unmarshal(body, &s) != nil || s.Exp < time.Now().Unix() {
		return nil
	}
	return &s
}

// sessionFrom reads `Authorization: Bearer ...` or the `session` cookie.
func sessionFrom(r *http.Request) *Session {
	if auth := r.Header.Get("Authorization"); strings.HasPrefix(auth, "Bearer ") {
		return verifySession(strings.TrimPrefix(auth, "Bearer "))
	}
	if c, err := r.Cookie("session"); err == nil {
		return verifySession(c.Value)
	}
	return nil
}
